title: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage
seo_title: A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage in Springfield
description: A touring stage production of A Charlie Brown Christmas, in which Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Lucy, Linus and the Peanuts gang put on their own Christmas play and discover the true meaning of the season. It is adapted from the animated TV special by Charles M. Schulz and features music by Vince Guaraldi, and it is meant for the whole family. It takes place Sunday, December 20, 2026 at 7:00 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO; all patrons need a ticket regardless of age.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
